name: agent-toolkit
description: Plugins for making a repo work well with coding agents: lean CLAUDE.md files, a project constitution with a why for every principle, and a lead agent that delegates and reviews.

plugins.name: agent-context
plugins.description: Quality for the files an agent reads every session: lean CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md files (with a linter), and a project constitution whose every principle carries its why.

plugins.name: repo-memory
plugins.description: Shared, hierarchical PITFALLS.md: lessons live next to the code they're about, and the agent sees only the headings in scope, once per session. A rule teaches where and how to write them so they're found.

plugins.name: orchestrate
plugins.description: Lead a feature as the senior engineer: a strong model plans, briefs cheaper subagents, reviews their work adversarially and reports at checkpoints, raising to you only what truly needs you.

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: A four-row status line: session and tasks, project and git status, model and context used, cost, time and rate limits. Installed by hand with /statusline:setup.
